tagline.en: Tencent's HunyuanVideo — a large open-weight video model for text-to-video and image-to-video.
tagline.zh: 腾讯的 HunyuanVideo——大型开放权重视频模型，支持文生视频与图生视频。

en: HunyuanVideo is Tencent's video generation model, offering both text-to-video and image-to-video. It's one of the larger open-weight video foundation models, generating a clip from a prompt or animating a source image.

In WorldFoundry, both the text-to-video and image-to-video routes are declarative recipes assembled by the shared native diffusion runner. The pipeline wires up the canonical network, prompt encoders, a causal 3D VAE, scheduler, and loaders through role-based components.
You supply the checkpoints locally. The Hugging Face license metadata is listed as "other," so review Tencent's upstream terms before redistribution.
zh: HunyuanVideo 是腾讯推出的视频生成模型，同时支持文生视频与图生视频。它是规模较大的开放权重视频基础模型之一，可从提示词生成片段，或让一张源图动起来。
在 WorldFoundry 中，文生视频与图生视频两条路径都是由共享的原生扩散 runner 组装的声明式配方。pipeline 通过基于角色的组件接入标准网络、提示词编码器、因果 3D VAE、调度器与加载器。
你在本地自备 checkpoint。其 Hugging Face 许可元数据标注为 "other"，再分发前请查阅腾讯的上游条款。

whenToUse.en: Choose HunyuanVideo when you want a large, capable video foundation model with both text-to-video and image-to-video, and can supply the checkpoints yourself.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个大型、能力强的视频基础模型，同时具备文生视频与图生视频，且能自备 checkpoint 时，可选 HunyuanVideo。

notFor.en: Its Hugging Face license is listed as "other" — review the upstream terms before redistribution. Checkpoints are large external assets, so plan for download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 其 Hugging Face 许可标注为 "other"——再分发前请查阅上游条款。checkpoint 是较大的外部资产，请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。
